# fresh-vdyp

> Agent-facing index for fresh-vdyp. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.
- [Program plan](https://github.com/UBC-FRESH/fresh-vdyp/blob/main/notes/plan/0001-program-plan.md): mission, scope, targets, and evidence levels.
- [Data provenance](https://github.com/UBC-FRESH/fresh-vdyp/blob/main/notes/plan/0002-data-provenance.md): source classes, manifest schema, and publication boundary.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/UBC-FRESH/fresh-vdyp/blob/main/notes/plan/0003-architecture.md): package, runner, API, web, assistant, and FEMIC boundary.
- [Validation and release](https://github.com/UBC-FRESH/fresh-vdyp/blob/main/notes/plan/0004-validation-release.md): golden evidence, gates, and integration.
